summary: Build practical HR change tools, adoption plans, and executive reporting skills in this 5-day intermediate course.
lede: Change Management for HR Transformation gives HR professionals a practical, repeatable way to assess readiness, map stakeholder impacts, analyse resistance, and plan communications. Using structured approaches such as ADKAR, Prosci’s change management approach, and Kotter’s 8-Step Process, you will turn people-side change into clear actions and measurable adoption progress. Build practical artefacts including stakeholder maps, resistance logs, readiness assessments, communication plans, adoption scorecards, and change action plans. The course also explores how AI-assisted HR service models, digital workflow automation, and cloud-based HR platforms affect change impacts and manager support while helping you balance competing priorities and maintain service continuity.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for HR professionals and change practitioners who support HR transformation, system rollout, policy redesign, and workforce adoption. It is especially useful when you need to coordinate people-side change across HR operations, managers, and employees.
modules: HRIS Adoption and Digital Workflow Change
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include working knowledge of HR operations, HR transformation projects, or organizational change activity. You should be comfortable reading stakeholder maps, policy documents, process flows, and basic project updates. No coding is required, but participants should bring a laptop for template work, digital exercises, and document-based group tasks. Prior exposure to HRIS implementations, change communications, or service redesign will help you apply the examples faster.
